doc: dev or prod. Prod ignores .env and dev secrets and refuses unsafe settings.
The control-plane Postgres URL for the runtime role. Printed with only the password hidden. Prod needs sslmode=require or verify-full unless the host is loopback or a Unix socket.
The control-plane Postgres URL for the migrator role (deedglass_migrator), used only by deedglass migrate. Dev falls back to DEEDGLASS_DATABASE_URL; prod requires it or --database-url.
Address the API, the Gate and the Console listen on (host:port).
The URL people and agents use to reach this server. Prod needs https.
Path to the seal key file used to seal deeds.
Path to an ML-DSA-65 seal key file (keys rotate --alg ML-DSA-65). With it, deeds carry a second, post-quantum seal beside Ed25519 (deed v2, ADR-109).

A key ring of 1 to 4 comma-separated base64 keys of exactly 32 bytes; the first encrypts connector credentials, the rest only decrypt during a rotation (S16). config print shows only the key ids (kek:…). Dev generates one in .deedglass/.
Base64 of at least 32 bytes, mixed into API key hashes. Keep it stable: changing it invalidates every API key. Dev generates one in .deedglass/.
Log level.
Who can join: invite (people an admin invites) or closed.
Resend API key for sign-in and approval emails (starts with re_). Without it, dev prints emails to the log.
The From address of sign-in and invite emails, e.g. Deedglass <signin@deedglass.com>. Required when DEEDGLASS_RESEND_API_KEY is set.
Optional Anthropic API key for Insights phrasing (starts with sk-ant-).
The Claude model that rewords Insights suggestions when an org turns phrasing on (a model id like claude-sonnet-5-5, no date suffix).
Comma-separated CIDRs whose X-Forwarded-For is believed.
Dev only: lets connectors reach private networks. Refused in prod.

Comma-separated CIDRs of private networks connectors may reach, in prod too, for example 10.20.0.0/16. Never cloud metadata, reserved, IPv4-embedding or loopback ranges. Deedglass's own database is reachable only when its exact address is listed (a /32 or /128).
Address for a separate listener serving Prometheus metrics at /metrics (host:port). Off when unset; bind it to localhost or a private network.
Alert when a Postgres replication slot holds more WAL than this (1-1048576 MB).
Dev only: decoder runners stop reading after their current poll, so tests can see late evidence. Refused in prod.
An agent or admin API key (dg_live_… or dg_test_…) for client commands.
A file holding the agent key (mode 0600, an absolute path), read when DEEDGLASS_API_KEY is unset; deedglass connect prints it in the MCP line so the key stays out of the client's config.
The Deedglass server client commands talk to.

The admin DSN deedglass connector postgres init connects with to prepare a customer database (a superuser, or a role with CREATEROLE such as the RDS master user). Read once, never stored or printed. Rename it with --admin-dsn-env.
Never show the terminal banner or the inline mark (bare deedglass, version, help). Scripts, pipes and CI never see them anyway.
Draw the terminal mark for a light or dark terminal. auto: COLORFGBG decides, else dark.
Never show the one-line GitHub star note after a scan. It shows at most once per machine, only in a terminal, and never in CI or with --json; scan --no-star hides it for one run.
Turn off the Sealed animation at the end of deedglass init; only its final frame shows.
Where the Pro licence token lives (default .deedglass/licence.json); the key sits next to it as licence.key. Both are 0600. Free commands never read it.
Never call Dodo Payments or deedglass.com. Pro keeps working on the cached licence inside its 14-day offline window.
Which Dodo Payments mode licence keys come from: live, or test for test-mode keys while setting up checkout.
Where licence tokens are signed (default https://deedglass.com); a local site in development.
